rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Kantei's account dated 1 October 2024 says that on the afternoon of that day both Houses held the designation ballots and 石破茂 was designated as the 102nd Prime Minister counting from Itō Hirobumi.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-13 only (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-12). Each House's designation vote, any joint committee and the House of Representatives' prevailing resolution, the Imperial appointment ceremony, Kantei statements and accounts, the Official Gazette's appointment and loss-of-office notices, the Cabinet's minutes, a cabinet's formation, its resignation en masse, any continued performance of duties and acting designations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row.
